_comment: Commission plans for the estimate shown in Program Submissions (combined). Every plan is month-to-date for the current calendar month, regardless of the selected date range. 'Won' means opportunity status = won: the first won transition, once per opportunity id, in the Army CA or Veteran G.I. Bill pipeline, credited to the opportunity owner at the won event. A 'submission' is a CA 101 submission or an IAU App Submitted (FS2). Each rep's plan is named in config/sales-reps.json. Amounts are USD. Estimated from dashboard counts; the official commission calculation is done outside this dashboard. Owner decision 2026-10-13 (edits round 6).

submission-retro.label: per submission
submission-retro.description: A flat amount per combined submission; once the month reaches the threshold, the higher rate applies retroactively to every submission that month.

per-won-flat.label: per won
per-won-flat.description: A flat amount per won opportunity. Submissions do not pay.

won-tiered.label: won tiered
won-tiered.description: A higher amount for each of the first N won opportunities in the month, then a lower amount for each one after. Not retroactive. Submissions do not pay.
